title: The Overture of AI-Tunes
description: Welcome to 🎵 TuneTailor, where we elevate your local music experience beyond mere playback. It's not just another player; it's about intelligence.
panel_text: A user looking bored at a basic music player, then a spotlight hits a logo that says "🎵 TuneTailor".

title: The Alexa Serenade Stream
description: Requests can hit us from anywhere, like your `alexa_skill`. A `LaunchRequest` comes in, we grab that `API_URL` and send it off.
panel_text: An Alexa Echo device with speech bubbles connecting to a server rack labelled "🎵 TuneTailor Backend".
speech_bubble: An Alexa Echo device with speech bubbles connecting to a server rack labelled "🎵 TuneTailor Backend".

title: The Intent Symphony
description: This is where the magic happens. We've got `INTENTS` defined in `src/config/constants.js`, ready to be fed to our Gemini LLM via the `GEMINI_BASE_URL`.
panel_text: A diagram showing a thought bubble transforming into structured data, with "INTENTS" labels and a big "Gemini" logo.
speech_bubble: A diagram showing a thought bubble transforming into structured data, with "INTENTS" labels and a big "Gemini" logo.

title: Your Solo, New Contributor
description: Want to dive in? The `public/app.js` handles the `Dynamic Dashboard` and manages your `songs`. Plenty of space to add new features or fine-tune existing ones.
panel_text: A developer happily coding at a computer showing a "Dynamic Dashboard" with music controls and a "CONTRIBUTE!" banner.
speech_bubble: A developer happily coding at a computer showing a "Dynamic Dashboard" with music controls and a "CONTRIBUTE!" banner.
